core.github.settings.tokenTips:
This launcher logs in through a GitHub App authorization and uses it only to search public repositories and fetch release lists. It cannot read or modify your repositories.
Before logging in, set the App's Authorization callback URL to http://127.0.0.1 (any port), then put client_id (and client_secret, if you have one) into BML/githubApp.json.
